Sol.51.(a) Cordial -  friendly and pleasant in behaviour. Amiable -  a  person  who  is  friendly  and good-natured. Rude -impolite or disrespectful in manner. Harsh -  very  rough  or  severe  in  tone  or behaviour. Severe -  extremely  strict  or  serious  in attitude.
Sol.52.(c)  Summit -  the highest point or peak. Pinnacle - the topmost or highest point. Base - the bottom part. Depth - the deepest point. Decline - downward movement.
Sol.53.(a)  Gloomy -  dark  in  a  way  that makes you feel sad. Melancholic -expressing feelings of sadness. Cheerful - feeling or showing happiness. Animated -full of interest and energy. Vibrant - lively and energetic.

Sol.60.(a)  Ill-famed -  known  for  a  bad reputation. Disreputable -  not respected because of bad behaviour. Respectable -considered proper or socially acceptable. Distinguished -highly respected and admired for achievements. Honorable -morally upright and principled.
Sol.61.(b) bubbly - someone who is full of joy, laughter and good spirits. Cheerful -happy,  positive  and  full  of liveliness. Melancholy - a feeling of sadness which lasts for a long time. Miserable - very unhappy or depressed. Depressed -  feeling  extremely  sad  and low.
Sol.62.(c) Fraudulent -  someone  who cheats or deceives. Deceitful -  one  who  hides the truth, lies, or tricks others. Candid -openly straightforward and direct without reserve or secretiveness. Forthright - direct and straightforward in speech. Genuine - it is real and exactly what it appears to be.
Sol.63.(a)  Noticeable -  something  that can be easily seen or observed. Conspicuous -  something  that  attracts attention because it is easily visible. Hidden - being out of sight or not readily apparent. Concealed
-  covered  or  disguised  so  it cannot be seen.
